title: Carriage by Air Ordinance
verified_how: Browser pane: https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap500. Title 'Cap. 500 Carriage by Air Ordinance'. Current version dated 13/12/2024.
notes: Gives effect to the Montreal and Warsaw Conventions: carrier liability for passenger death or injury, delay, and baggage. Hong Kong has no statutory denied-boarding or cancellation compensation scheme like EU261.
